body.mechanism: The static Sx source can receive score-bearing authority only through one exact prior model family whose no-terrain refit reproduces the frozen M115 action and hence the unchanged Champion algebra before any assessment score.
body.treatment: No-fit code/schema/provenance audit of one M115+terrain feature family.
body.control: Frozen M115 generator, N7 action identity and Champion algebra; no fit/predict/score.
body.metric: Boolean source-chain, schema, nonduplication, chronology, matched-control and strict-comparison-contract gates.
